1jehuang/jcode.name: jcode
1jehuang/jcode.description: A RAM-efficient coding-agent harness for running an agent from the terminal with a small local footprint.
1jehuang/jcode.first_test: Install it with the project script and point it at a disposable clone. Ask for one test-only change, measure memory use, and inspect the diff before any commit step.

3b1b/manim.name: manim
3b1b/manim.description: A Python engine for precise programmatic animations. This repository is ManimGL, installed as manimgl; it renders scenes from Python and can use LaTeX for math text.
3b1b/manim.first_test: Install manimgl with Python 3.10+ and FFmpeg, then run manimgl example_scenes.py OpeningManimExample. Render one short explainer and keep its dependencies separate from Manim Community.

abseil/abseil-cpp.name: abseil-cpp
abseil/abseil-cpp.description: A collection of C++17 utility libraries for strings, containers, synchronization, time, hashing, and other common low-level tasks.
abseil/abseil-cpp.first_test: Build the library and compile one small example against it. Run the project's tests and check the selected C++ standard before adding Abseil to a production build.

addyosmani/agent-skills.name: agent-skills
addyosmani/agent-skills.description: A pack of 24 workflow skills for definition, planning, implementation, testing, review, performance, simplification, and release work in coding agents.
addyosmani/agent-skills.first_test: Install the pack with npx skills add addyosmani/agent-skills. In one real repo, run /spec, /plan, and /test on a small change, then keep it if the outputs provide useful evidence.

affaan-m/ECC.name: ECC
affaan-m/ECC.description: A collection of engineering skills, memory, security checks, research-first workflows, and performance guidance for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and Cursor.
affaan-m/ECC.first_test: Install one workflow in a disposable repository and run it on a small issue. Check the generated plan, tests, and permission requests before adding the full collection.

agegr/pi-web.name: pi-web
agegr/pi-web.description: A web interface for the pi coding agent that lets users start and observe coding-agent sessions from a browser.
agegr/pi-web.first_test: Run it against a disposable repository and complete one read-only task. Check login, terminal output, working directory, and session cleanup before exposing the web interface.

AgriciDaniel/claude-seo.name: claude-seo
AgriciDaniel/claude-seo.description: An SEO audit plugin for Claude Code built from 26 sub-skills and 19 agents, covering technical SEO, Core Web Vitals, structured data, AI search citation, and local, e-commerce, and international SEO, with a prioritized action plan.
AgriciDaniel/claude-seo.first_test: Run one audit on a site you own and pick 3 of its highest-priority findings. Check each against Search Console or PageSpeed data before acting on any recommendation.

akitaonrails/ai-memory.name: ai-memory
akitaonrails/ai-memory.description: A Rust project for long-term memory in agent coding CLIs and for handing context between different agent vendors.
akitaonrails/ai-memory.first_test: Use it in a disposable repository with one remembered project rule. Start a second agent session and confirm exactly what context is retrieved before storing client-specific notes.

alibaba/open-code-review.name: open-code-review
alibaba/open-code-review.description: A code-review system that combines deterministic rules with an LLM agent and reports findings at exact source lines, including rules for common security and correctness issues.
alibaba/open-code-review.first_test: Run it on a test pull request with one known defect. Compare the line comment with a human review and inspect the configured rules before connecting the service to a live repository.

alibaba/page-agent.name: page-agent
alibaba/page-agent.description: A JavaScript in-page GUI agent that controls web interfaces with natural-language instructions without a browser extension or headless browser.
alibaba/page-agent.first_test: Add it to a local test page and ask it to read one field. Inspect the generated actions and block submit or delete actions until selectors and confirmation checks are explicit.

alirezarezvani/claude-skills.name: claude-skills
alirezarezvani/claude-skills.description: A collection of reusable skills, agents, commands, scripts, and reference files for Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and other coding tools.
alirezarezvani/claude-skills.first_test: Install 1 skill into a disposable project, inspect its SKILL.md and scripts, and run it on public test data before adding it to a persistent agent profile.

Alishahryar1/free-claude-code.name: free-claude-code
Alishahryar1/free-claude-code.description: A launcher for terminal, desktop, IDE, and Discord workflows with Claude Code, Codex, Pi, OpenCode, and local model providers. It includes server and client commands for connecting those tools.
Alishahryar1/free-claude-code.first_test: Install it in a test account and run fcc-server with one provider. Use fcc-claude on a read-only repository, then check the provider, token path, and command log before using a paid account.

android/skills.name: skills
android/skills.description: Official modular agent skills that ground coding agents in Android development patterns, tools, and workflows documented by the Android team.
android/skills.first_test: Install only the r8-analyzer skill into 1 disposable Android project, run it against a test release configuration, and compare every finding with the generated R8 files and Android documentation.

Anil-matcha/Open-Generative-AI.name: Open-Generative-AI
Anil-matcha/Open-Generative-AI.description: A self-hosted image and video generation studio that connects to many model providers through a web interface. It is released under the MIT license and supports configurable model access.
Anil-matcha/Open-Generative-AI.first_test: Run it with a local test configuration and generate one image from a prompt you wrote. Record the provider, model, input, and output license before using the result commercially.

anomalyco/opencode.name: opencode
anomalyco/opencode.description: An open-source coding agent available as a terminal interface and desktop app, with a full-access build agent and a read-only plan agent for code exploration.
anomalyco/opencode.first_test: Run the read-only plan agent in 1 disposable repository and ask it to trace a single function call path. Confirm it makes no file changes before testing the build agent.

anthropics/claude-code.name: claude-code
anthropics/claude-code.description: An agentic coding tool for terminal, IDE, and GitHub workflows that can inspect code, explain it, and perform routine tasks.
anthropics/claude-code.first_test: Give it 1 read-only question in a test repository. Check its file access and answer before authorizing edits.

anthropics/claude-plugins-community.name: claude-plugins-community
anthropics/claude-plugins-community.description: A read-only mirror of community plugins approved for the Claude Cowork and Claude Code plugin marketplace. Its marketplace.json file is synced from Anthropic's review pipeline.
anthropics/claude-plugins-community.first_test: Add the marketplace to Claude Code and install one plugin by name. Read that plugin's files and permissions, run one harmless command, and remove it if its access is broader than the task needs.

anthropics/claude-plugins-official.name: claude-plugins-official
anthropics/claude-plugins-official.description: Anthropic's maintained directory of Claude Code plugins, including plugin manifests, skills, hooks, commands, and agent integrations.
anthropics/claude-plugins-official.first_test: Choose one plugin from its manifest, install it in a test project, and read every hook it enables. Run one command before allowing it to edit files or call external services.

anthropics/financial-services.name: financial-services
anthropics/financial-services.description: Claude plugins and reference material for financial analysis, investment research, due diligence, and other financial-services workflows.
anthropics/financial-services.first_test: Install one relevant plugin and test it with a public company filing. Check every number against the source document and keep the result as analysis support, not financial advice.

anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins.name: knowledge-work-plugins
anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins.description: A collection of plugins for knowledge-work tasks in Claude Cowork, with commands and workflows for roles such as research, writing, and analysis.
anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins.first_test: Install one role-specific plugin and run it on a public source. Check the generated files and tool permissions, then remove commands that do not fit your actual workflow.

anthropics/skills.name: skills
anthropics/skills.description: Anthropic's public repository of example Agent Skills for Claude, including the document skills for Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and PDF files, the Agent Skills specification, and a skill template.
anthropics/skills.first_test: Add it as a Claude Code plugin marketplace and install only document-skills. Ask for 1 short PDF form-field extraction from a test file and check the output against the original document.

antirez/ds4.name: ds4
antirez/ds4.description: A native local-inference engine for DeepSeek 4 and related models on Metal, CUDA, and ROCm, with an HTTP server and coding-agent mode.
antirez/ds4.first_test: Build it on a supported test machine and run the smallest model command. Measure model load, memory, tokens per second, and server access before exposing it to other users.

apache/maka.name: maka
apache/maka.description: A local-first AI agent workspace that records model messages, tool calls, tool results, permission decisions, and termination events in an append-only session log.
apache/maka.first_test: On a supported Apple Silicon Mac, build it from source with npm ci and npm run dev. Run one read-only repository task, then inspect the tool timeline, permission decisions, and saved session record.

apple/container.name: container
apple/container.description: A macOS command-line tool for running Linux containers inside lightweight virtual machines on Apple Silicon, with OCI images and isolated networking.
apple/container.first_test: Run container system start and container run --rm alpine echo hello. Check volume, network, and cleanup behavior before placing a build or agent task inside it.

AprilNEA/OpenLogi.name: OpenLogi
AprilNEA/OpenLogi.description: A Rust local-first alternative to Logitech Options+ for remapping buttons, DPI, and SmartShift over HID++ without an account or telemetry.
AprilNEA/OpenLogi.first_test: Test it with one supported mouse on a non-critical profile. Export or note the original device settings first, then verify each remap before using it during client work.

asgeirtj/system_prompts_leaks.name: system_prompts_leaks
asgeirtj/system_prompts_leaks.description: A reference corpus of collected system-prompt files from several AI products and agents. It is useful for comparing instruction layers, but the files are not official guarantees.
asgeirtj/system_prompts_leaks.first_test: Read one prompt as a text sample and label its source and date. Compare its rules with the product's public documentation, and do not copy private or product-specific text into a deployed system.

ATH-MaaS/Pixelle-Video.name: Pixelle-Video
ATH-MaaS/Pixelle-Video.description: A web-based short-video pipeline that turns a topic into a script, images or video, voice narration, music, subtitles, and a final composition.
ATH-MaaS/Pixelle-Video.first_test: Use a non-client topic and one short output. Check the generated script, media licenses, voice, and subtitle timing before you reuse any asset in a public campaign.

ayghri/i-have-adhd.name: i-have-adhd
ayghri/i-have-adhd.description: A coding-agent output skill that asks for concise answers, clear next actions, and less buried information when a task has many details.
ayghri/i-have-adhd.first_test: Install it and run the same small task with and without the skill. Compare the location of the answer, risks, and next action, then keep only useful changes in your project instructions.

basecamp/omarchy.name: omarchy
basecamp/omarchy.description: A Shell-based Linux setup from Basecamp that packages an opinionated desktop environment and development workstation configuration.
basecamp/omarchy.first_test: Install it only in a VM or spare machine first. Record which packages, dotfiles, and services it changes before using the setup on a daily workstation.

BasedHardware/omi.name: omi
BasedHardware/omi.description: A wearable and desktop second-brain system that captures conversations or screens, transcribes them, and produces summaries, action items, and chat context.
BasedHardware/omi.first_test: Use it for one non-sensitive meeting or screen session. Read the transcript, summary, and stored data location, then remove the recording before testing it with private material.

bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view.name: gods-eye-view
bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view.description: A browser-based 3D globe that displays public aircraft, ship, satellite, earthquake, traffic, and camera feeds.
bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view.first_test: Open a public region in the local demo. Check the data source and timestamp before using any scene in a visual report.

blader/humanizer.name: humanizer
blader/humanizer.description: A Markdown agent skill that rewrites AI-sounding prose while aiming to preserve its meaning.
blader/humanizer.first_test: Apply it to a draft paragraph, then compare claims line by line with the source before using the copy in a client report.

block/buzz.name: buzz
block/buzz.description: A communication platform from Block for organising conversations and shared work around a common space.
block/buzz.first_test: Create a test workspace with two accounts and send one message. Check roles, notifications, export, and deletion before moving a real team channel.

bojieli/ai-agent-book.name: ai-agent-book
bojieli/ai-agent-book.description: An open Chinese book about AI-agent design and engineering, with the full text, a compiled PDF, and code examples arranged by chapter.
bojieli/ai-agent-book.first_test: Read one chapter and run its matching example. Change one input, compare the output with the explanation, and record the dependency versions before using the pattern elsewhere.

boykopovar/AnyPS5.name: AnyPS5
boykopovar/AnyPS5.description: A compatibility tool that relinks clean PS5 ELF executables into native Linux, Windows, or macOS formats and supplies system-library implementations without a separate emulator process.
boykopovar/AnyPS5.first_test: Build the relinker in a test environment, then run its import audit on 1 lawfully obtained compatible sample. Review every absent or stubbed import before attempting to launch the output.

bradautomates/claude-video.name: claude-video
bradautomates/claude-video.description: A Claude Code skill that downloads a video, extracts frames, transcribes speech, and gives the combined evidence to Claude through the /watch command.
bradautomates/claude-video.first_test: Run /watch on a short local or permitted video and ask one timestamped question. Check the extracted frames and transcript against the source before using the answer.

browser-use/video-use.name: video-use
browser-use/video-use.description: A coding-agent tool for editing video from a footage folder and a natural-language request, with a final video written to the project directory.
browser-use/video-use.first_test: Give it three short test clips and ask for one cut. Inspect the edit decision, timestamps, and final.mp4, then confirm that the source files were not overwritten.

browserbase/skills.name: skills
browserbase/skills.description: Browserbase's official agent skills for web navigation, page interaction, extraction, and browser automation workflows.
browserbase/skills.first_test: Install one skill and run it against a public test page. Check the selected elements and extracted values against the page before adding login or form-submit actions.

BuilderIO/agent-native.name: agent-native
BuilderIO/agent-native.description: A framework for defining application actions that can be used from a user interface, agent, HTTP, MCP, A2A, or CLI client.
BuilderIO/agent-native.first_test: Define one read-only action and call it from two supported clients. Assert the same input validation and result shape before adding an action that changes data.

bytedance/UI-TARS-desktop.name: UI-TARS-desktop
bytedance/UI-TARS-desktop.description: A multimodal desktop agent stack with a CLI, web UI, browser and computer-use tools, MCP support, and model adapters for visual interaction.
bytedance/UI-TARS-desktop.first_test: Install the desktop client and use it on a test account. Ask it to open one local application and report the screen action sequence before allowing clicks that change data.

cactus-compute/needle.name: needle
cactus-compute/needle.description: A 45-million-parameter local model for tool calling and structured extraction. It is distributed in a small file, returns schema-constrained JSON, and supports confidence thresholds.
cactus-compute/needle.first_test: Install cactus-needle, define one typed Python tool, and call agent.run() with an invoice example. Accept a device action only above a confidence threshold that you set and test.

calesthio/OpenMontage.name: OpenMontage
calesthio/OpenMontage.description: An agentic video-production system that coordinates media preparation, planning, editing, and rendering through a pipeline called Backlot.
calesthio/OpenMontage.first_test: Run make setup and open one sample project with python -m backlot open. Use test footage, inspect each pipeline step, and verify the final render before adding client media.

can1357/oh-my-pi.name: oh-my-pi
can1357/oh-my-pi.description: A terminal coding-agent toolkit with file and shell tools, LSP support, Python execution, browser access, subagents, and a customizable agent loop.
can1357/oh-my-pi.first_test: Install it and point it at a disposable repository. Ask for a test-only change, inspect the tool calls and LSP diagnostics, and reject any unrequested file edits.

cathrynlavery/diagram-design.name: diagram-design
cathrynlavery/diagram-design.description: A skill for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi that creates 27 diagram types as static HTML and SVG. Use it for architecture, flows, data models, and timelines; it can also redraw Mermaid or draw.io sources.
cathrynlavery/diagram-design.first_test: Install the skill, then give it one client process, such as a booking flow. Ask for an architecture or swimlane diagram, open the HTML, and remove any node that does not help the reader.

citrolabs/ego-lite.name: ego-lite
citrolabs/ego-lite.description: A local browser for AI agents that can share an existing logged-in browser state with tools such as Codex or Claude Code.
citrolabs/ego-lite.first_test: Use a separate browser profile and a public test site first. Check which cookies and tabs are exposed, then keep all payment and admin accounts out of the shared profile.

CJackHwang/ds2api.name: ds2api
CJackHwang/ds2api.description: A Go middleware service that converts a DeepSeek web conversation interface into OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini-compatible API formats, with a React administration interface.
CJackHwang/ds2api.first_test: Run it locally with the documented Docker or Go path and send one test request. Inspect the request translation and terms of service before connecting a real account or client traffic.

CloakHQ/CloakBrowser.name: CloakBrowser
CloakHQ/CloakBrowser.description: A source-patched Chromium build intended as a drop-in Playwright or Puppeteer browser for controlled browser testing and automation.
CloakHQ/CloakBrowser.first_test: Run the supplied browser example against a local test page. Review the security, compliance, and site terms first; do not use it to bypass access controls or anti-abuse systems.

cloudflare/security-audit-skill.name: security-audit-skill
cloudflare/security-audit-skill.description: A coding-agent skill that organizes repository security audits into reconnaissance, coverage-led hunting, candidate validation, structured findings, independent verification, and source-backed reports.
cloudflare/security-audit-skill.first_test: Install it in an isolated agent profile and audit one disposable sample repository. Check that coverage-ledger.json and findings.json pass the included validators before reading the generated reports.

cocoindex-io/cocoindex.name: cocoindex
cocoindex-io/cocoindex.description: A Python data-transformation engine that updates downstream indexes incrementally instead of rebuilding all data after every change.
cocoindex-io/cocoindex.first_test: Install it with pip install -U cocoindex and transform a small fixture. Change one source row, run the pipeline again, and confirm that only the expected target records changed.

colbymchenry/codegraph.name: codegraph
colbymchenry/codegraph.description: A local code knowledge graph that indexes a repository, syncs after code changes, and serves context to coding agents through CLI and MCP clients.
colbymchenry/codegraph.first_test: Run codegraph init in a disposable clone and index one module. Ask for a caller list, compare it with the language tools, and check what files the agent can read before enabling edits.

Comfy-Org/ComfyUI.name: ComfyUI
Comfy-Org/ComfyUI.description: A node-graph engine and interface for building reusable local workflows for image, video, audio, 3D, and text models, with queueing, workflow templates, and API integration.
Comfy-Org/ComfyUI.first_test: Use the official desktop app to load 1 maintained text-to-image template, generate 1 low-resolution image, and save the workflow JSON. Reopen it offline and confirm the graph and parameters are preserved.

cordiverse/cordis.name: cordis
cordiverse/cordis.description: A TypeScript meta-framework described by its maintainers as a framework for spatiotemporal composability.
cordiverse/cordis.first_test: Read the core concepts and run the smallest documented example. Use it only if the composition model is clearer than a normal framework for the workflow you are testing.

cursor/plugins.name: plugins
cursor/plugins.description: Cursor's plugin specification and a set of official plugins that package skills, commands, agents, and integrations for the Cursor editor.
cursor/plugins.first_test: Read one plugin manifest and install it in a test project. Run its smallest command, inspect file and network access, and keep only the pieces that match your workflow.

datawhalechina/easy-vibe.name: easy-vibe
datawhalechina/easy-vibe.description: A step-by-step course for beginners who want to build modern software with AI-assisted development and ship working projects.
datawhalechina/easy-vibe.first_test: Start one lesson in a clean project and complete its exercise without skipping the verification step. Keep the generated code only after you can explain its entry point and test.

davila7/claude-code-templates.name: claude-code-templates
davila7/claude-code-templates.description: A CLI and catalog of Claude Code agents, commands, settings, hooks, skills, MCP integrations, project templates, monitoring tools, and installation diagnostics.
davila7/claude-code-templates.first_test: Run the interactive catalog in a temporary profile and install one component. Inspect every written configuration file, run its health check, and remove the profile after confirming the component's scope.

debpalash/VoiceStudio.name: VoiceStudio
debpalash/VoiceStudio.description: A local voice-production app for speech generation, voice design, dubbing, dictation, transcription, and agent connections.
debpalash/VoiceStudio.first_test: Generate a short clip with a permitted voice. Check pronunciation, file storage, and consent before using it in client media.

decolua/9router.name: 9router
decolua/9router.description: A local AI router that presents one endpoint for several coding clients and providers, translates request formats, and can fail over between configured models.
decolua/9router.first_test: Configure one provider and one low-risk coding request. Inspect the route, model, token count, and error fallback in the logs before adding more providers or secrets.

DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp.name: codebase-memory-mcp
DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp.description: A local MCP server that builds code intelligence from Tree-sitter parsing and a graph, with a static binary and support for many programming languages.
DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp.first_test: Install the binary and index a small repository. Ask for a symbol definition and callers, compare both with the source, and check the MCP client permissions before enabling edits.

diegosouzapw/OmniRoute.name: OmniRoute
diegosouzapw/OmniRoute.description: A local AI gateway that exposes one endpoint for many model providers and translates requests for clients such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Copilot.
diegosouzapw/OmniRoute.first_test: Run it on the local port with one provider and one low-risk prompt. Inspect the selected model, request log, costs, and fallback behavior before adding credentials for other providers.

DietrichGebert/ponytail.name: ponytail
DietrichGebert/ponytail.description: An agent skill that prompts coding agents to solve tasks with smaller, simpler code changes.
DietrichGebert/ponytail.first_test: Apply it to 1 small bug in a disposable branch. Compare the diff and test results with the normal agent workflow.

different-ai/openwork.name: openwork
different-ai/openwork.description: An open-source desktop workspace for sharing AI workflows, skills, MCP connections, and connected services across compatible agents and team members.
different-ai/openwork.first_test: Install it with a test workspace and connect one non-sensitive capability. Use search_capabilities and execute_capability on a harmless action, then review access and sign-in scope.

docusealco/docuseal.name: docuseal
docusealco/docuseal.description: A self-hosted document workflow for creating PDF forms, filling them, and collecting digital signatures. The project includes a Docker deployment path.
docusealco/docuseal.first_test: Start the Docker container with a test volume and create one non-sensitive form. Complete it with a test signer, then verify the PDF, audit trail, and storage location.

DuarteSantos8/openGym.name: openGym
DuarteSantos8/openGym.description: A self-hosted workout and body-weight tracker for planning routines, logging guided sessions, viewing training status, importing fitness-app data, and signing in with passkeys.
DuarteSantos8/openGym.first_test: Use the public demo to create 1 routine and log 1 sample workout. Check the muscle and progress views, then test the export before deciding whether to self-host it.

earendil-works/pi.name: pi
earendil-works/pi.description: An AI-agent toolkit with a unified LLM API, agent loop, terminal UI, and coding-agent CLI for building or running local agent workflows.
earendil-works/pi.first_test: Run the CLI with one configured model and a read-only repository task. Save the tool trace, check the API endpoint, and test cancellation before using it in automation.

earthtojake/text-to-cad.name: text-to-cad
earthtojake/text-to-cad.description: An agent plugin with local workflows for generating STEP, GLB, STL, and 3MF models, checking manufacturability, and producing engineering drawings.
earthtojake/text-to-cad.first_test: Install the release-channel plugin in 1 test agent, disable telemetry if needed, and generate a simple dimensioned box. Inspect the model in the local viewer and export 1 STEP file.

Effect-TS/effect.name: effect
Effect-TS/effect.description: A TypeScript library for typed errors, dependency injection, structured concurrency, scheduling, tracing, and schema validation in production applications.
Effect-TS/effect.first_test: Install effect in a strict TypeScript scratch project and model 1 operation with a typed error. Test both its success and failure paths before using it in an application.

Egonex-AI/Understand-Anything.name: Understand-Anything
Egonex-AI/Understand-Anything.description: A coding-agent plugin that analyzes a repository into an interactive knowledge graph, dashboard, and searchable explanations.
Egonex-AI/Understand-Anything.first_test: Install it in a disposable clone and run /understand. Compare one graph relationship with the source code, then use /understand-diff before accepting a change.

EpicGames/raddebugger.name: raddebugger
EpicGames/raddebugger.description: A native graphical debugger for local Windows x64 programs with PDB support, multi-process debugging, a custom RAD Debug Info format, and related linker tools.
EpicGames/raddebugger.first_test: Download 1 prebuilt alpha release on a Windows x64 test machine and debug a small program. Verify a breakpoint, variable inspection, and process switching before using it on a larger codebase.

esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix.name: DeepSeek-Reasonix
esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix.description: A terminal coding agent built around DeepSeek models, with a persistent session, prefix-cache handling, extensions, and ACP support.
esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix.first_test: Install the CLI and run one read-only task in a disposable repository. Check model configuration, cached files, shell commands, and cancellation before leaving it running.

EveryInc/compound-engineering-plugin.name: compound-engineering-plugin
EveryInc/compound-engineering-plugin.description: An engineering plugin for Claude, Codex, Cursor, and related agents that packages repeatable research, planning, implementation, review, and delivery workflows.
EveryInc/compound-engineering-plugin.first_test: Install one command in a test repository and run it on a small change. Review the plan and generated tests, then keep the workflow only if each step produces evidence you can inspect.

EvoMap/evolver.name: evolver
EvoMap/evolver.description: A JavaScript engine for self-evolving agents. It stores proposed changes as Genes, Capsules, and Events so you can review what changed before you run the next cycle.

facebook/astryx.name: astryx
facebook/astryx.description: A React 19 and StyleX design system with reusable packages, customizable tokens, and conventions intended to be understandable by coding agents.
facebook/astryx.first_test: Install the packages and rebuild one button from the examples. Check token values, generated CSS, and keyboard states before using it as a product design system.

Fincept-Corporation/FinceptTerminal.name: FinceptTerminal
Fincept-Corporation/FinceptTerminal.description: An AGPL desktop finance application with market analytics, investment research, and economic data tools. The public repository is the free edition for learning and academic use.
Fincept-Corporation/FinceptTerminal.first_test: Build the free edition and load a small set of historical data. Check the data source and date for every chart; do not use the output as a trading instruction without independent review.

flutter/flutter.name: flutter
flutter/flutter.description: Google's open-source SDK for building mobile, web, and desktop applications from one Dart codebase.
flutter/flutter.first_test: Create 1 starter app and run it on macOS and the web. Change 1 widget with hot reload, then compare layout and input behavior on both targets.

fmtlib/fmt.name: fmt
fmtlib/fmt.description: A C++ formatting library that provides string formatting and output APIs.

freestylefly/awesome-gpt-image-2.name: awesome-gpt-image-2

OpenCut-app/OpenCut.name: OpenCut
OpenCut-app/OpenCut.description: An open-source video editor that is being rewritten with a web interface and a plugin-first architecture. The repository is an active work in progress.
OpenCut-app/OpenCut.first_test: Run the documented web development command with sample media. Test one cut and export path, then check the current issue list before relying on it for a production edit.

opengeos/GeoLibre.name: GeoLibre
opengeos/GeoLibre.description: A lightweight, cloud-native GIS platform for viewing and analysing geospatial data in browsers, desktop apps, mobile apps, and Jupyter notebooks.
opengeos/GeoLibre.first_test: Load a small public GeoJSON file and render one layer. Check coordinate reference, feature count, and export output before connecting private location data.

openinterpreter/openinterpreter.name: openinterpreter
openinterpreter/openinterpreter.description: A coding-agent harness for running open models such as Kimi from a terminal, with a workflow that can emulate common agent commands.
openinterpreter/openinterpreter.first_test: Install it in a test environment and run /harness on a small repository. Check the model endpoint, shell permissions, and final diff before enabling unattended actions.

oven-sh/bun.name: bun
oven-sh/bun.description: A JavaScript and TypeScript runtime that also provides a package manager, bundler, test runner, and script launcher in one executable.
oven-sh/bun.first_test: Install Bun in a sample project, run bun install, then run one script and one test. Compare the result with the project's current Node command before changing the build tool.

Panniantong/Agent-Reach.name: Agent-Reach
Panniantong/Agent-Reach.description: A command-line skill that gives agents access to web pages and services such as X, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, and Xiaohongshu through fallback backends.
Panniantong/Agent-Reach.first_test: Install it and fetch one public post from one supported service. Check the returned URL, timestamp, and text against the source before using it in a report.

paperclipai/paperclip.name: paperclip
paperclipai/paperclip.description: An open-source Node.js server and React interface for coordinating teams of AI agents around goals, tasks, reporting lines, budgets, approvals, and work history.
paperclipai/paperclip.first_test: Run the local quickstart with a throwaway organization, one goal, and one test agent. Confirm that its task, budget, approval, and activity records remain visible before connecting a real agent.

pascalorg/editor.name: editor
pascalorg/editor.description: A browser-based editor for creating and sharing 3D architectural projects.
pascalorg/editor.first_test: Open a sample project and change one wall or material. Export or share the result, then check saved coordinates and asset ownership before using it for a client presentation.

pbakaus/impeccable.name: impeccable
pbakaus/impeccable.description: Design guidance for AI coding agents, packaged as one skill with 24 commands, live browser iteration, and deterministic checks for frontend design problems.
pbakaus/impeccable.first_test: Install it in a disposable frontend project, run /impeccable init, and audit 1 page. Compare every reported issue with the rendered page before keeping any suggested change.

penpot/penpot.name: penpot
penpot/penpot.description: An open-source design platform for interfaces, components, variants, and design tokens, with a self-hosted deployment option.
penpot/penpot.first_test: Start the documented self-hosted demo and rebuild one small component. Check token inheritance, component variants, and export output before migrating a real design file.

permissionlesstech/bitchat.name: bitchat
permissionlesstech/bitchat.description: A Bluetooth mesh chat application with an IRC-style interface that can pass messages between nearby devices without a central server.
permissionlesstech/bitchat.first_test: Install two test devices and send a short message with Bluetooth permissions visible. Check delivery range, identity, persistence, and metadata before using it for sensitive communication.

phuryn/pm-skills.name: pm-skills
phuryn/pm-skills.description: A set of product-management skills and commands for discovery, strategy, planning, execution, launch, and growth workflows.
phuryn/pm-skills.first_test: Install one skill and apply it to a real but low-risk feature. Compare its problem statement, acceptance criteria, and launch checks with your existing brief before adopting more commands.

pingdotgg/t3code.name: t3code
pingdotgg/t3code.description: A control surface with mobile, web, and desktop clients for starting and managing local coding-agent sessions.
pingdotgg/t3code.first_test: Run it against a disposable repository and complete one read-only task from the web client. Check authentication, local process scope, and session logs before enabling edits.

PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent.name: prime-agent
PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent.description: A coding and research agent for long tasks. It keeps a Python session, subagents, goals, schedules, and reusable skills so work can resume after a terminal disconnects.
PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent.first_test: Start it inside a disposable clone and give it one bounded task, such as a pull-request review. Check prime-agent status, agents, and attach before accepting changes in the real project.

public-apis/public-apis.name: public-apis
public-apis/public-apis.description: A curated list of free public APIs, organized by category, with links and usage notes maintained in a GitHub repository.
public-apis/public-apis.first_test: Pick one API for a test integration and verify its current docs, auth rules, rate limits, and license from the source site before using it in a proposal or demo.

ranxianglei/billion-context.name: billion-context
ranxianglei/billion-context.description: A context-compression proxy and plugin that folds consumed coding-agent conversation into layered summaries and exposes tools for compression, restoration, search, and context status.
ranxianglei/billion-context.first_test: Run 1 disposable coding session through the documented client launcher and inspect acp_status after a compression. Compare the restored details with the original transcript before using it on client work.

refactoringhq/tolaria.name: tolaria
refactoringhq/tolaria.description: A desktop application for browsing and editing Markdown knowledge bases with local files and a focused note-taking interface.
refactoringhq/tolaria.first_test: Open a copy of one Markdown folder and edit one note. Check links, front matter, and the saved file on disk before pointing the app at the real knowledge base.

revfactory/harness.name: harness
revfactory/harness.description: A harness for running coding agents with reusable instructions, tools, and workflow controls from a local development environment.
revfactory/harness.first_test: Run one agent task in a disposable clone and record its prompt, tools, files, and final diff. Add a human approval step before allowing the harness to commit or push.

Robbyant/lingbot-map.name: lingbot-map
Robbyant/lingbot-map.description: A 3D streaming-reconstruction model that builds a spatial map from visual input for research and interactive scene understanding.
Robbyant/lingbot-map.first_test: Create the documented environment and run the demo on a short local sequence. Compare the reconstructed points with the input frames before using it for measurement.

rohitg00/agentmemory.name: agentmemory
rohitg00/agentmemory.description: A persistent memory service for coding agents and MCP clients. It stores project context and exposes a demo server for checking how memory is added and retrieved.
rohitg00/agentmemory.first_test: Run the setup and agentmemory demo --serve in a disposable project. Store one fact, retrieve it in a new session, and verify the record before adding private notes.

rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch.name: ai-engineering-from-scratch
rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch.description: A hands-on course that teaches AI engineering by building and shipping small projects with an agent as a tutor.
rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch.first_test: Install its skills and run /start-learning for one topic. Make the smallest exercise yourself, run its test, and record what you changed before asking the agent for the next lesson.

run-llama/liteparse.name: liteparse
run-llama/liteparse.description: A local document parser for PDFs and other files that returns text with page and spatial information for retrieval and structured extraction.
run-llama/liteparse.first_test: Parse one PDF containing a table and compare the returned text and bounding boxes with the page. Add a fixture for the layout before building a search pipeline on it.

ruvnet/ruflo.name: ruflo
ruvnet/ruflo.description: A multi-agent orchestration framework for coordinating workflows with memory, learning, retrieval, and Claude-compatible tools. It provides a harness for routing work between agents.
ruvnet/ruflo.first_test: Run one two-step workflow in a disposable repository. Save the agent messages and tool calls, then verify that the second agent receives only the context that you intended.

ruvnet/RuView.name: RuView
ruvnet/RuView.description: A WiFi-sensing system that estimates presence, movement, and some vital-sign signals from radio data without using a camera.
ruvnet/RuView.first_test: Run ruview doctor and ruview verify in a test room. Compare the output with a known movement test and treat any health-related signal as experimental, not a medical measurement.

semantica-agi/semantica.name: semantica
semantica-agi/semantica.description: A Python library for storing entities, relationships, decisions, rules, and source links in a knowledge graph. It can trace decisions, flag conflicts, and export an audit trail.
semantica-agi/semantica.first_test: Install it with pip install semantica. Record one vendor choice with its reason and source, then call trace_decision_chain() and check_decision_rules() before using it in a report.

Shubhamsaboo/awesome-llm-apps.name: awesome-llm-apps
Shubhamsaboo/awesome-llm-apps.description: A catalog of runnable open-source applications for agents, RAG, multimodal models, and other LLM workflows, with code that can be cloned and adapted.
Shubhamsaboo/awesome-llm-apps.first_test: Choose one small application, create its environment, and run its README example. Trace the model, data, and secret path before copying the pattern into a client project.

simplex-chat/simplex-chat.name: simplex-chat
simplex-chat/simplex-chat.description: A private messaging system whose network avoids global user identifiers and provides mobile, desktop, and terminal clients.
simplex-chat/simplex-chat.first_test: Install two test clients and send a message over a fresh connection. Check identity setup, backups, notifications, and metadata behavior before inviting a real contact.

soxoj/maigret.name: maigret
soxoj/maigret.description: A Python OSINT CLI that checks a username across more than 3,000 sites and builds a report from the responses.
soxoj/maigret.first_test: Run it only for your own username or with written permission. Compare one positive result with the source site because a matching name is not proof of identity.

stablyai/orca.name: orca
stablyai/orca.description: A desktop and mobile workspace for running several coding agents in parallel, with separate worktrees and support for agents such as Codex, Claude, OpenCode, and Pi.
stablyai/orca.first_test: Run two agents on separate worktrees for the same small issue. Compare their diffs and merge one manually; check that neither agent can modify the other's branch.

Starmel/OpenSuperWhisper.name: OpenSuperWhisper
Starmel/OpenSuperWhisper.description: A macOS dictation application that runs Whisper or Parakeet speech models locally and inserts the transcription into the active application.
Starmel/OpenSuperWhisper.first_test: Install it with brew install opensuperwhisper and download one local model. Dictate a short note, check punctuation and hotkeys, and confirm the audio stays local.

storytold/artcraft.name: artcraft
storytold/artcraft.description: A desktop IDE for AI-assisted image and video creation with 2D compositing, 3D scene staging, character posing, camera controls, and selectable generation models.
storytold/artcraft.first_test: Open 1 release build, compose a simple scene from 2 image layers, and generate 1 still. Save the project, reopen it, and confirm the composition and model settings remain editable.

supermemoryai/supermemory.name: supermemory
supermemoryai/supermemory.description: A memory and context system that stores information from apps and agent sessions and retrieves relevant facts for later work.
supermemoryai/supermemory.first_test: Run the local or MCP setup with one non-sensitive note. Retrieve it in a new session, inspect the stored record, and test deletion before importing a larger knowledge base.

supertone-inc/supertonic.name: supertonic
supertone-inc/supertonic.description: An ONNX text-to-speech engine that runs on-device and supports multilingual speech generation across 31 languages.
supertone-inc/supertonic.first_test: Install it with pip install supertonic and synthesize one short sentence in two languages. Check latency, voice quality, output format, and whether the model runs without a network call.

swc-project/swc.name: swc
swc-project/swc.description: A Rust-based compiler toolkit for parsing, transforming, and compiling JavaScript and TypeScript, with libraries and tools for high-speed builds.
swc-project/swc.first_test: Build one example transform and compare its output with the source test. Run the project's test command before replacing a compiler in an existing build pipeline.

tailscale/tailcat.name: tailcat
tailscale/tailcat.description: A netcat-like CLI and Go library for encrypted peer connections over Tailscale's data plane without its control plane.
tailscale/tailcat.first_test: Connect 2 test machines with its documented example. Verify the peer address exchange and tunnel behavior before using it for remote work.

tashfeenahmed/freellmapi.name: freellmapi
tashfeenahmed/freellmapi.description: A self-hosted router that exposes OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and optional Ollama-compatible APIs across free-model providers, with routing, failover, encrypted keys, and a local dashboard.
tashfeenahmed/freellmapi.first_test: Read the install script before running it, then start a local Docker instance with one test provider key. Send one request and verify the selected model, fallback behavior, key storage, logs, and data directory.

TauricResearch/TradingAgents.name: TradingAgents
TauricResearch/TradingAgents.description: A multi-agent framework for researching and simulating trading decisions. It separates analyst roles and combines their reports into a final market analysis.
TauricResearch/TradingAgents.first_test: Run it on historical data with paper-trading settings. Compare the report with a simple baseline and record the data date, assumptions, and transaction costs before trusting any signal.

Tencent/WeKnora.name: WeKnora
Tencent/WeKnora.description: An open-source knowledge platform for turning documents into a searchable RAG system, reasoning agent, and wiki.
Tencent/WeKnora.first_test: Import a few public documents and ask 1 source-specific question. Confirm the answer cites the correct passage.

TencentCloud/CubeSandbox.name: CubeSandbox
TencentCloud/CubeSandbox.description: A RustVMM and KVM-based sandbox for AI agents with hardware isolation, concurrent startup, snapshots, rollback, and compatibility with E2B-style SDKs.
TencentCloud/CubeSandbox.first_test: Launch one disposable sandbox and run a harmless command. Measure startup and cleanup, test snapshot rollback, and check the host boundary before running untrusted code.

TencentCloud/Octop.name: Octop
TencentCloud/Octop.description: A self-hosted, multi-user AI assistant that combines multiple agents with a web dashboard, CLI, messaging channels, connectors, knowledge bases, and scheduled tasks.
TencentCloud/Octop.first_test: Run octop init and octop run in a disposable local profile, create 1 test user and expert, and inspect the data directory and tool approval flow before connecting an account.

TencentCloud/TencentDB-Agent-Memory.name: TencentDB-Agent-Memory
TencentCloud/TencentDB-Agent-Memory.description: A self-hosted memory server for agent teams. It turns conversations, documents, and code into Chat Memory, Skills, Wiki, and CodeGraph assets that can be shared by client tools.
TencentCloud/TencentDB-Agent-Memory.first_test: Copy .env.example to .env, run ./start-all.sh, and open localhost:8125. Import one runbook and one codebase, then give a reviewer only the assets it needs.

thedotmack/claude-mem.name: claude-mem
thedotmack/claude-mem.description: A Claude Code plugin that captures session work, compresses it, and injects relevant context into later sessions. It supports persistent project memory instead of relying on one chat window.
thedotmack/claude-mem.first_test: Install it with npx claude-mem install in a test project. Complete one small task, start a new session, and verify that the recalled context is correct before using it for client work.

THU-MAIC/OpenMAIC.name: OpenMAIC
THU-MAIC/OpenMAIC.description: A multi-agent interactive classroom built with a web interface and AI agents for guided learning sessions.
THU-MAIC/OpenMAIC.first_test: Use the public demo for one SEO training topic. Check the lesson flow and source handling before considering it for client education.

tinyhumansai/openhuman.name: openhuman
tinyhumansai/openhuman.description: A local-first personal AI system that combines memory, agent orchestration, workflows, and deep research in one desktop application.
tinyhumansai/openhuman.first_test: Install it without personal data and run one research task using public sources. Inspect the memory store and outbound requests before importing notes or connecting accounts.

tirth8205/code-review-graph.name: code-review-graph
tirth8205/code-review-graph.description: A local code-intelligence graph for MCP and CLI clients that maps a repository so agents can focus on relevant files during code review.
tirth8205/code-review-graph.first_test: Index a small repository and ask for one review path. Compare the returned files with the actual call graph, then check the context reduction before trusting a large-repo review.

ToolJet/ToolJet.name: ToolJet
ToolJet/ToolJet.description: A visual builder for internal apps with tables, forms, charts, JavaScript, Python, and connections to databases, APIs, SaaS tools, and object storage.
ToolJet/ToolJet.first_test: Run the Docker quickstart with test data and build a small order dashboard. Check the data source, access rules, empty state, and error state before using real records.

Tracer-Cloud/opensre.name: opensre
Tracer-Cloud/opensre.description: An OpenSRE framework for agents that investigate incidents on infrastructure you control. It provides onboarding, investigation commands, and a place to record evidence and actions.
Tracer-Cloud/opensre.first_test: Install it with pipx or the project script and run opensre onboard on a test service. Give it one known alert and check that each conclusion links to a log or command result.

trycua/cua.name: cua
trycua/cua.description: Infrastructure, SDKs, and benchmarks for computer-use agents that control full macOS, Linux, and Windows desktops in sandboxes.
trycua/cua.first_test: Start one sandbox and run the smallest desktop benchmark. Measure startup, screen access, file access, and cleanup, then keep the agent on a test account until those boundaries are clear.

tt-a1i/archify.name: archify
tt-a1i/archify.description: A Node.js rendering and validation system that compiles typed JSON architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams into self-contained HTML and SVG.
tt-a1i/archify.first_test: Try the skill without installing it and generate one workflow diagram from a small system description. Open the HTML, compare every node and route with the source, and run the documented validator.

unclebob/swarm-forge.name: swarm-forge
unclebob/swarm-forge.description: A tmux and Git worktree system for coordinating several coding agents with role prompts, branch-specific configurations, and message passing.
unclebob/swarm-forge.first_test: Run the smallest documented pack on a disposable repository. Check each worktree, role prompt, and handoff message, then merge one change manually before scaling the swarm.

usekaneo/kaneo.name: kaneo
usekaneo/kaneo.description: A self-hosted, open-source project-management application with a focused interface for projects, tasks, and team work.
usekaneo/kaneo.first_test: Start the documented instance and create one test project with two tasks. Check roles, notifications, export, and backup before importing a real project.

usestrix/strix.name: strix
usestrix/strix.description: An AI-assisted penetration-testing tool that scans a local application, explains possible vulnerabilities, and helps investigate fixes.
usestrix/strix.first_test: Run strix --target against a deliberately vulnerable local app. Reproduce one finding manually, record the request and fix, and use it only on systems you are authorised to test.

vectorize-io/hindsight.name: hindsight
vectorize-io/hindsight.description: An agent memory system with retain, recall, and reflect operations, available through a self-hosted API, an embedded Python mode, client libraries, and an MCP server.
vectorize-io/hindsight.first_test: Start a local instance, retain three facts in a test memory bank, and recall one of them. Inspect the returned evidence and delete the test data before evaluating a production integration.

vercel-labs/open-agents.name: open-agents
vercel-labs/open-agents.description: An open-source reference app for running background coding agents with a web interface, Vercel runtime, sandboxes, and GitHub integration. It is a starting point for building a custom service.
vercel-labs/open-agents.first_test: Fork it and run one agent against a test repository. Trace the request, sandbox, branch, and pull request path so you know where credentials and generated files go.

vercel/next.js.name: next.js
vercel/next.js.description: A React framework for building full-stack web applications with current React features and Rust-based JavaScript tooling.
vercel/next.js.first_test: Complete 1 page from the official Learn Next.js course, run it locally, and check the production build before considering it for a client site.

virattt/dexter.name: dexter
virattt/dexter.description: An agent for deep financial research that gathers company information, performs analysis, and produces a cited research result.
virattt/dexter.first_test: Ask one bounded question about a public company and require source links. Check the source dates and calculations line by line before using the report in a decision.

virgiliojr94/book-to-skill.name: book-to-skill
virgiliojr94/book-to-skill.description: A tool that turns a technical book PDF into a Claude Code skill for study, reference, and task support.
virgiliojr94/book-to-skill.first_test: Use a public-domain or permitted PDF and generate one small skill. Check every instruction against the page number it came from before installing it in an agent.

vitali87/code-graph-rag.name: code-graph-rag
vitali87/code-graph-rag.description: A CLI that parses a multi-language repository with Tree-sitter and stores its code structure in Memgraph for symbol queries, caller searches, dead-code checks, and edit previews.
vitali87/code-graph-rag.first_test: Index a disposable clone with cgr daemon up and cgr start --repo-path /path/to/repo --update-graph. Ask one function question and inspect the source and graph path before allowing an edit.

volcengine/OpenViking.name: OpenViking
volcengine/OpenViking.description: A Python context database for AI agents that combines agent memory, knowledge RAG, and skills in one storage layer.
volcengine/OpenViking.first_test: Run the smallest local example with one public document and one saved memory. Check what is indexed, how retrieval is scored, and how records are deleted before adding private material.

warpdotdev/warp.name: warp
warpdotdev/warp.description: A terminal-based development environment with command history, workflows, and support for built-in or external coding agents.
warpdotdev/warp.first_test: Open a test project and run one read-only agent task. Check the command preview, working directory, environment variables, and generated files before enabling automatic execution.

wonderwhy-er/DesktopCommanderMCP.name: DesktopCommanderMCP
wonderwhy-er/DesktopCommanderMCP.description: An MCP server that gives an agent terminal control, filesystem search, file reads, diffs, and edits from a connected desktop environment.
wonderwhy-er/DesktopCommanderMCP.first_test: Run it in a sandbox folder with list, search, and diff requests only. Confirm the allowed path and command policy before enabling file writes or shell execution.

xbtlin/ai-berkshire.name: ai-berkshire
xbtlin/ai-berkshire.description: A set of value-investing research skills for Claude and Codex that combines financial statements, valuation methods, and adversarial review into a report.
xbtlin/ai-berkshire.first_test: Run one skill on a public annual report and keep the source pages with the output. Recalculate one key ratio yourself and treat the result as research, not a recommendation.

yikart/AiToEarn.name: AiToEarn
yikart/AiToEarn.description: A Chinese and English platform for using AI to create and distribute content across several publishing and marketing services, with plugin and MCP integrations.
yikart/AiToEarn.first_test: Connect only a test account and publish one private draft. Check the generated copy, platform permissions, and deletion path before linking a production social account.

Z4nzu/hackingtool.name: hackingtool
Z4nzu/hackingtool.description: A menu of more than 200 security tools across recon, OSINT, web, wireless, forensics, and post-exploitation categories, with an AI layer that suggests commands.
Z4nzu/hackingtool.first_test: Use it only on systems that you own or are authorised to test. Pick one local lab target, run one tool manually first, and save the command and permission record with the result.

Zackriya-Solutions/meetily.name: meetily
Zackriya-Solutions/meetily.description: A local meeting assistant that records or imports calls, transcribes speech, and produces searchable notes and summaries without requiring a hosted service.
Zackriya-Solutions/meetily.first_test: Run it on a short test recording with consent from everyone involved. Compare the transcript with the audio, check where files are stored, and delete the recording after the test.

zhaoxuya520/reverse-skill.name: reverse-skill
zhaoxuya520/reverse-skill.description: A skill router for authorised reverse engineering and penetration testing that selects tools, bootstraps them when needed, and stores reusable research notes.
zhaoxuya520/reverse-skill.first_test: Run it only against a local lab target. Check the selected tool and command before execution, save the evidence, and remove any tool that has a broader scope than the test needs.

ZhuLinsen/daily_stock_analysis.name: daily_stock_analysis
ZhuLinsen/daily_stock_analysis.description: A multi-market stock-analysis application that combines market data, news, an LLM analysis workflow, dashboards, and optional notifications.
ZhuLinsen/daily_stock_analysis.first_test: Run python main.py --dry-run with a public symbol and inspect the input date and sources. Compare the output with the raw data; do not place trades from the generated analysis.

zilliztech/claude-context.name: claude-context
zilliztech/claude-context.description: An MCP plugin that uses semantic search to find relevant code across a large repository and provide that context to Claude Code or another coding agent.
zilliztech/claude-context.first_test: Install the Node 20+ package in a disposable clone and index it. Ask for one symbol's callers, compare the result with rg, and allow write tools only after the search is accurate.
